meta.title: Party Watcher — watch videos together with friends and live streams
meta.description: Party Watcher is a free watch party service: watch YouTube, Twitch and VK Video together with friends in sync, with chat and voice. Live streams online and your own streams via OBS.
meta.ogDescription: Watch YouTube, Twitch and VK Video together with friends — in sync, with chat and voice. Or start your own stream with rewards and clips.

intro.title: Watch videos together with friends — and stream yourself
intro.text: Party Watcher is a service for watch parties and live streams. Create a room, share the link — and everyone watches the same video in sync: YouTube, Twitch, VK Video, Google Drive. Rooms have text chat and voice. You can also go live through OBS — with channel-point rewards, clips, alerts and moderation.

info.youtube_twitch:
Paste a YouTube video link (youtube.com/watch?v=... or youtu.be/...), a Twitch recording (VOD) link (twitch.tv/videos/1234567890 — a recording, not a live stream) or a VK Video link (vk.com/video-123_456, vkvideo.ru/video-123_456 or the embed code).
The service is detected automatically from the link.
A private VK video can only be embedded with its embed code ("Share" → "Export").
info.drive:
(not tested)
In Google Drive: right-click the video → "Share" → "Anyone with the link" → copy the link and paste it here. Otherwise the server cannot read the file.
info.player_capture:
Paste a link to a page where the video (a movie or series) already plays — that page’s player will be shown to everyone in the room in sync.
Not every site works: if no video is found, try another page.
⚠️ my.mail.ru is not supported.
Some sites let you pick the season/episode/player.
Whoever creates the room is responsible for its links and videos (see the terms).
info.direct:
Paste a READY direct video link — a regular site page address will NOT work here (e.g. a my.mail.ru watch page), only:
• a link to the video file itself: .mp4, .m3u8
• a link to an embed player that the site ITSELF allows to embed (not all sites allow it, e.g. my.mail.ru).
Such a link usually has to be found in the page source — the server does not look for it, unlike “Movie / series viewing”.
info.kodik:
Paste a Kodik player link — the video plays right at each viewer (fast). Kodik mostly has anime, dramas, Turkish, Indian and other Eastern series and films.

What the link looks like: https://kodikplayer.com/serial/12345/abc…/720p (or /video/…, /season/…).

How to get it from a page with an embedded Kodik player:
• Firefox: right-click the player → “This Frame” → “Open Frame in New Tab” → copy the address from the new tab.
• Chrome, Edge, Yandex Browser: press F12 → Ctrl+F → type kodik → copy the link from src="…" of the iframe tag.

The host switches season, episode and voice-over right in the player — viewers switch along.
Whoever creates the room is responsible for its links and videos (see the terms).
info.kodikSearch: 🔎 You have Kodik catalog search: start typing the title of an anime, drama or series and pick a voice-over.

about.title: What is Party Watcher
about.text: Party Watcher is a website for watching videos and live streams together. Create a room, send the link to your friends — and everyone watches the same video at the same time: pause, seeking and switching videos happen for everyone at once. Works with YouTube, Twitch, VK Video, Google Drive and direct video links.
about.q1: How do I watch videos together with friends?
about.a1: Sign up, create a room, paste a video link and send your friends the room link or its key. The room has chat and voice, and the player stays in sync for everyone — like sitting in front of one screen.
about.q2: Where can I watch live streams?
about.a2: The “Live streams” section shows broadcasts that are live right now: games, talk shows, music and creative streams. With an account you can chat, follow streamers, earn channel points and spend them on channel rewards.
about.q3: How do I start my own stream?
about.a3: Open the creator studio, get your stream key and go live with OBS. Your channel gets a moderated chat, channel point rewards, clips, past broadcasts and alerts right in OBS.
about.a4: Yes. Party Watcher is free and has no ads.
